Shipperform

Shipperform is an innovative platform designed to help shippers contract transportation services more efficiently in the logistics sector.

Contact us

The Solution for Logistics Efficiency

The name Shipperform accurately reflects its ability to improve shippers’ efficiency. The platform allows them to quickly and effectively access the best quotes and most competitive transportation services.

The platform helps shippers obtain the best prices through an automated quote management process. This process covers both maritime and land transport.

Shipperform unifies and simplifies logistics processes. The coverage ranges from moving goods by sea to road transport for final destination delivery.

Efficient Integration: The Complete Supply Chain Solution

The platform’s integration with port systems and land carrier networks ensures a coordinated and efficient workflow.

Furthermore, it promotes visibility and information sharing among all supply chain stakeholders, such as shippers, carriers, port operators, and terminals.

Nexus Shipperform promises to be a complete solution for shippers and consignees. It offers an integrated platform to manage all aspects of their transportation contracts, from pre-loading to final delivery.

Key Features

Quote Management and Service Contracting

- Multimodal Quotation Platform: Allows users to access real-time maritime and land transport quotes, considering variables such as cost, transit time, and service availability.
- Tenders/RFQ Process: Allows land carriers to bid on transportation services for pre-loading and post-loading of goods.
- Combined Services Contracting: The platform supports the combination of land and sea transportation services, allowing users to manage the entire transportation operation in an integrated manner.

Port System Integration

- Data Normalization: The platform handles data normalization from various sources, such as APIs, files in multiple formats (PDF, Excel, etc.), and online forms, transforming them into a standard internal format.

Data Integration Layer

- Ability to customize cost rules for billing, adjusting values according to specific customer and container needs, including storage fees, handling, and routes.
- Users with permissions can easily edit or add new cost rules.

Operations Visibility and Tracking

- SHoT Platform (Container Tracking System): Integration with the Nexus SHoT platform to track all stages of container delivery or collection, for both import and export processes.

Electronic Payments

- Integration with Nexus Payment: The platform is prepared to integrate with the Nexus electronic payment system, facilitating payment for contracted services, both for road and maritime transport.

Benefits of the Shipperform Solution

Operational Efficiency

Shipperform automates and centralizes many of the typically manual and time-consuming processes in the transportation and logistics industry.

Its integration with port systems and automatic loading of containers into each consignee’s profiles contributes to greater fluidity and efficiency.

Cost Reduction

By allowing shippers to compare real-time quotes and optimize their transportation operations, the platform helps reduce costs by identifying the most economical solutions based on variables such as cost, transit time, and service quality.

Visibility and Traceability

Integration with the Nexus SHoT system offers complete visibility of transportation operations, from collection to final delivery, enabling more effective and transparent supply chain management.

 
Unified Contracting Process

The ability to manage and contract land and sea services in an integrated manner on a single platform simplifies the logistics process, eliminating the need for multiple systems or transportation service providers.

Data Normalization

With the data integration layer, Nexus Shipperform solves the problem of data format diversity, transforming unstructured information into standardized data that can be used to optimize logistics operations.

Add-ons and Integrations

Cargofive Integration

Integrates maritime transport quotes directly into the platform, allowing users to consult and book services from various shipping companies in one place.

Nexus Payment Integration

Enables management of electronic payments for contracted services, making the process faster and more secure.

Nexus SHoT Integration

Tracks and provides visibility to all operations associated with container delivery or collection, for both import and export.

API for Carriers and Shippers

The platform provides an open API for carriers and shippers to automate their service requests and bid responses directly in their management systems.
